# nutanix_category (Resource)

Manages a user-defined Nutanix Prism category through the Prism v4.3 API.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Immutable category key in the Prism `key:value` identity.
- `value` (String) Category value. Updating it preserves the remote `extId`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional category description, limited to 512 characters by Prism.
- `owner_uuid` (String) Optional owner UUID for an update; Prism assigns the creator on create.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Prism category `extId`.
- `type` (String) Prism category type. User-defined resources report `USER`.
